name: Ryzon
verdict: Ryzon (RYZON GmbH, Cologne) is owned by its founders Markus and Mario Konrad and Fabian Jung, with Jan Frodeno holding 20.69% (Kölner Stadt-Anzeiger, 2025). Nothing found.
note: Kit partner (apparel maker) of Canyon//SRAM from the Tour de France Femmes 2026 (team announcement, 28 July 2026). Rating note: founder-owned with Jan Frodeno at 20.69% (claim ryzon-founders-ownership); no state capital; no relevant human-rights record found.
